item.title: Version 0.1.5
item.description: Chat for Claude Code and Codex on iPhone and iPad: live replies, coloured code, Stop and approvals A cleaner sidebar: agents named by their task, state with its age, panes you can open into, double-click to rename ⌘+ and ⌘- zoom the pane you are in, ⌘0 resets it Browsers open as tabs; merge one into any tab, or open beside on request Agents come back after a restart: Claude Code, Codex, pi and Kimi Code resume their sessions Agents in your panes know how to use Gudo: Claude Code, Codex and pi get a skill for running commands you can watch, starting other agents and using the browser Click a file path to open it in Gudo, with Markdown rendered Option and Command arrows move by word and line as in Ghostty iPhone keys: Esc, Ctrl, Tab, Enter and the arrows up front, and Paste works with text copied on a Mac Low Data Mode: hosts send less over a constrained connection Full VoiceOver support in the terminal, and stronger contrast throughout Newer terminal core with faster output and many fixes Security fixes for approvals, links and shell integration

item.title: Version 0.1.4
item.description: Updates show up in the sidebar Programs keep running through updates Claude Code and Codex look as they do in Ghostty Notifications when an agent finishes or needs you Easier SSH hosts and a new SSH Keys page Drawing, browser and tab improvements Security fixes for shared sessions
